import std.actor as actor

class Context:
    capacity: i64

class Booking:
    reference: i64
    seats: i64

class ReservationState:
    remaining: i64
    bookings: List[Booking]

enum Request:
    Reserve(reference: i64, seats: i64)
    Availability
    RestartForTest

enum BookingError:
    InvalidReference
    InvalidQuantity
    DuplicateReference(reference: i64)
    SoldOut(remaining: i64)

async def create(context: shared[Context]) -> Result[ReservationState, Error]:
    return ok(ReservationState(remaining=context.capacity, bookings=[]))

async def handle(state: ReservationState, request: Request) -> Result[actor.Turn[ReservationState, i64, BookingError], Error]:
    match request:
        case Request.Availability:
            remaining = state.remaining
            return ok(actor.turn[ReservationState, i64, BookingError](state, ok(remaining)))
        case Request.RestartForTest:
            return error("controlled restart; this sample stores bookings only in memory")
        case Request.Reserve(reference, seats):
            if reference < 1:
                return ok(actor.turn[ReservationState, i64, BookingError](state, fail(BookingError.InvalidReference)))
            if seats < 1:
                return ok(actor.turn[ReservationState, i64, BookingError](state, fail(BookingError.InvalidQuantity)))
            for index in range(len(view(state.bookings))):
                if state.bookings[index].reference == reference:
                    return ok(actor.turn[ReservationState, i64, BookingError](state, fail(BookingError.DuplicateReference(reference))))
            if seats > state.remaining:
                remaining = state.remaining
                return ok(actor.turn[ReservationState, i64, BookingError](state, fail(BookingError.SoldOut(remaining))))
            remaining = state.remaining - seats
            bookings = state.bookings
            append(bookings, Booking(reference=reference, seats=seats))
            next = ReservationState(remaining=remaining, bookings=bookings)
            return ok(actor.turn[ReservationState, i64, BookingError](next, ok(remaining)))

async def monitor(group: actor.Supervisor[Context]) -> Result[unit, Error]:
    return await actor.run(group)

async def call(worker: view[actor.Actor[Request, i64, BookingError]], request: Request) -> Result[Result[i64, BookingError], Error]:
    match await actor.call(worker, request, 1000, 1000):
        case Ok(reply):
            return ok(reply)
        case Err(_):
            return error("reservation worker unavailable")

async def value(worker: view[actor.Actor[Request, i64, BookingError]], request: Request) -> Result[i64, Error]:
    match try await call(worker, request):
        case Ok(remaining):
            return ok(remaining)
        case Err(_):
            return error("unexpected booking rejection")

async def exercise(first: actor.Actor[Request, i64, BookingError], second: actor.Actor[Request, i64, BookingError], control: actor.Control) -> Result[unit, Error]:
    match await actor.ready(view(first), 1000):
        case Ok(_):
            assert_true(True)
        case Err(_):
            try await actor.shutdown(view(control))
            return error("morning reservation worker did not start")
    match await actor.ready(view(second), 1000):
        case Ok(_):
            assert_true(True)
        case Err(_):
            try await actor.shutdown(view(control))
            return error("evening reservation worker did not start")
    assert_true(try await value(view(first), Request.Reserve(101, 3)) == 7)
    match try await call(view(first), Request.Reserve(101, 1)):
        case Ok(_):
            assert_true(False)
        case Err(problem):
            match problem:
                case BookingError.DuplicateReference(reference):
                    assert_true(reference == 101)
                case BookingError.InvalidReference:
                    assert_true(False)
                case BookingError.InvalidQuantity:
                    assert_true(False)
                case BookingError.SoldOut(_):
                    assert_true(False)
    match try await call(view(first), Request.Reserve(102, 8)):
        case Ok(_):
            assert_true(False)
        case Err(problem):
            match problem:
                case BookingError.SoldOut(remaining):
                    assert_true(remaining == 7)
                case BookingError.InvalidReference:
                    assert_true(False)
                case BookingError.InvalidQuantity:
                    assert_true(False)
                case BookingError.DuplicateReference(_):
                    assert_true(False)
    assert_true(try await value(view(first), Request.Availability) == 7)
    assert_true(try await value(view(second), Request.Reserve(201, 2)) == 8)
    match await actor.call(view(first), Request.RestartForTest, 1000, 1000):
        case Ok(_):
            assert_true(False)
        case Err(problem):
            assert_true(problem.kind == actor.CallKind.REPLY_LOST)
    restarted = False
    for attempt in range(200):
        if not restarted:
            match await actor.call(view(first), Request.Availability, 0, 100):
                case Ok(reply):
                    match reply:
                        case Ok(remaining):
                            assert_true(remaining == 10)
                            restarted = True
                        case Err(_):
                            assert_true(False)
                case Err(_):
                    await sleep(5)
    assert_true(restarted)
    assert_true(try await value(view(second), Request.Availability) == 8)
    try await actor.shutdown(view(control))
    return ok(print("reservations: validated duplicates, capacity, restart and sibling isolation"))

async def main() -> Result[unit, Error]:
    group = actor.supervisor[Context](Context(capacity=10), actor.default_options())
    first = try actor.register[ReservationState, Request, i64, BookingError](view(group), "morning", create, handle, actor.default_actor_options())
    second = try actor.register[ReservationState, Request, i64, BookingError](view(group), "evening", create, handle, actor.default_actor_options())
    control = actor.control(view(group))
    async with scope:
        spawn monitor(group)
        spawn exercise(first, second, control)
    return ok(assert_true(True))
